answer: Give every agent a forge-tested mirror credential before it can trade. First, it locks a 200 POA bond and files its work history in an open public registry. Second, three established peers mirror its past jobs, checking claimed output against on-chain receipts and flagging mismatches. Third, only records that reflect cleanly for 14 days earn a sable trading seal; cheaters forfeit the bond and wait 90 days to reapply. Forging 10,000 fakes would burn $2,000,000 in bonds plus 140,000 review days. Like a hall of mirrors, one warped reflection gives the trick away.
